sources.citation: Hsiu, Andrew. 2014. Mondzish: a new subgroup of Lolo-Burmese. In Proceedings of the 14th International Symposium on Chinese Languages and Linguistics (IsCLL-14), 62-81. Taipei: Academia Sinica. Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.1127814
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 2.3 'Mango and Manga' gives location, <50 elderly speakers, autonym ma55 ngo21, and 'Mango is the only Mondzish language that has final stops... /-t/ and /-k/'; appendix comparative wordlist has a 'Mango (Mumei)' column with syllable tones. The words stress/accent/prosody do not occur. Only Glottolog reference for mang1429.
